subtitle: Immersive Dominion — Five Personal Realms, Watchlist, Instant Picks & Storage Health
changes: Introduced a complete five-realm site visual upgrade: Sovereign Violet, Frozen Dominion, Obsidian Gold, Ember Throne and Midnight Eclipse, with atmospheric navigation, responsive accents and a personalized landing portal.

Immersion Console supports on-device atmosphere intensity, glass readability, background visibility and motion controls, preserving the exact original personal GIF, video and media publisher settings.
Mobile-adaptive visuals automatically switch off continuous theme animations on coarse-pointer mobile devices unless explicitly enabled; reduced-motion preferences always take precedence.
Added personal Watchlist movies stored as metadata in the existing local Video Vault; the new watchlist shelf and one-tap Watchlist Only filter retain local privacy.
Added Surprise Me selection favoring previously unwatched saved movies without autoplaying or leaving the application.
Added on-demand Local Library Health reports with saved original video file totals, browser storage estimates, and optional persistent-storage requests with clear safety guidance.
Updated responsive scene controls, improved site branding and theme palettes while preserving all 18 studios, v3.9 poster and playback tools, original local video bytes and offline rollback.
